_comment: TradeForge language catalogue — ENGLISH. Keys are stable identifiers, mirroring lang/hu.json (the base catalogue). Never invent a key here: a key that does not exist in hu.json is dead weight, and the test (tests/test_i18n.py) fails on it. The {name} placeholders must match hu.json exactly.
_comment_terms: Trading terms stay untranslated on purpose: spread, ATR, PF, MaxDD, WPR, SMA, BE, trailing, Risky, Fibo.

bt.slots_tip:
Number of slots that can be open at once — it sets the POSITION SIZE,
not the number of positions (one pair runs one trade anyway).
The risk is split across this many slots:
more slots = smaller lot. The default comes from
trading.max_open_slots in the config.
bt.initial_tip:
The backtest's starting capital ($). It scales the position size
(risk = balance × account_risk_pct) and the
percentage return. Empty = the config's
starting balance (starting_balance_eur).
bt.params_on_tab: The parameters live on the Parameters tab — the run uses the values entered there. (If you change them there, this tab refreshes itself.)
bt.preset_tip: Off = base handling (BE + trailing). Risky = halved size + immediate BE at 1R. Halving/Shield = close 50%/75% at 1R + runner. Fibo = stop to BE at 61.8% of the entry→TP distance (no partial close/trailing). Thirds = 1/3–2/3: after the base distance (1R) the stop goes to 1/3, at the target to 2/3. Shield↔Fibo = auto: Fibo on a big move, otherwise Shield (decided at entry).
bt.cautious_tip: Halved entry size. Risky always halves it; with Halving/Shield it can be switched on as extra caution.
bt.runner_tip: The stop of the piece left AFTER Halving/Shield's partial close (runner): Trailing / Stays away / BE / Exit signal.
bt.costcut_tip: Time stop: if the position is still losing after this many main bars (M15), we close it at market. Combines with any preset.
bt.exit_tip: Which indicator closes the remainder: Supertrend flip / WPR cross-back / Divergence.
bt.build_tip: Off / Manual / Auto. Auto: models it with any preset (it also builds on the risk-free runner, as in live). Manual: ONLY with an R-based trigger (deterministic) — candle-based Manual is a user click, we do not model that. A built package has no TP: it runs to the average-price stop / exit signal (as in live).
bt.factor_tip: Pyramid size multiplier: each add-on = previous × Factor (HOW MUCH).
bt.trigger_tip: Candle = trend following. Fixed R = +1R,+2R… (constant step). R-halving = the step shrinks → they get denser.
bt.rshrink_tip: The step's multiplier per add-on (0.5 = halving; 2/3; 3/4…).
bt.rr_note: (exploratory — not saved; in Auto mode Building is modelled with ANY preset (on the risk-free runner too, as in live), in Manual only with an R-based trigger. Only the original rr result is written back to the main screen.)
bt.build_csv_tip: The position building (add-on) rows ITEM BY ITEM for Excel: one row = one built trade, broken down by legs (pyramid), and HOW MUCH the add-on contributed in R and $. Only active if the run had add-ons (Building ≠ Off). ⚠ This is NOT the optimisation result — that is on the Trials tab (trials CSV).

bt.no_build_csv: No Building CSV — this run had no add-ons.

idlg.ez_a_keszlet_a: ⚠ This set was tuned WITHOUT THE EXECUTION GATES (spread + TF alignment), while live trading does gate → the backtest gives a different result than the optimiser showed. Re-run the OPT.
idlg.kezi_modositas_a_kovetkezo: Manual change — takes effect at the next Play:
idlg.a_pipa_bevonjuk_e:
The tick: whether the parameter is included in the search (pair+strategy level). The from/to/step is the STRATEGY's shared range — it affects every instrument.
Yellow = signal (recomputes the entry list) · blue = execution (only filters and sizes) · „—” = has no tunable range.
idlg.kockazatcsokkentes_ha_mar_bent: Risk reduction (once you are in a position)
idlg.ki_semmi_a_stop: Off (nothing) = the stop STAYS where it was at entry — no BE, no trailing (for measuring the raw strategy edge). BE + trailing = the former „Off”: breakeven at the BE %, trailing after that. Risky = halved size + immediate BE at 1R. Halving/Shield = close 50%/75% at 1R + separate handling of the remainder (runner). Fibo = stop to BE at 61.8% of the entry→TP distance (no close, no trailing — the stop stays, the TP runs). Thirds = 1/3–2/3: on covering the base distance (1R) the stop goes to 1/3 (in profit), at the target to 2/3. Shield↔Fibo = auto: Fibo on a big move (ATR >> average), otherwise Shield — decided at entry.
idlg.a_felezo_pajzs_reszleges: The stop of the piece left AFTER Halving/Shield's partial close (runner): Trailing (follows) / Stays away (original stop) / BE (to the entry) / Exit signal (closes on the indicator).
idlg.ido_stop_tananyag_ha: Time stop (educational): if the position is still losing after this many main bars (M15), we close it at market — cutting the wick/noise early for a fraction of an R. Combines with any preset.
idlg.ki_kezi_a_gombbal: Off / Manual (YOU build with the + button) / Auto (the engine does it). In the backtest: Auto always; Manual can ONLY be modelled with an R-based trigger (that one is deterministic).
idlg.piramidalis_meret_szorzo_minden: Pyramid size multiplier: each add-on = previous × Factor (down to min_lot). — HOW MUCH (the WHEN is the Trigger).
idlg.gyertyas_trendkoveto_uj_csucs: Candle = trend following (new high/low close). Fixed R = +1R, +2R… (constant step). R-halving = the step shrinks (1R, +0.5R, +0.25R…) → denser and denser. The R-based ones are deterministic.
idlg.az_elso_lepes_r: The (first) step in R (default 1R). With Fixed R it is the grid spacing; with R-halving the starting step.
idlg.a_lepes_szorzoja_add: The step's multiplier per add-on (0.5 = halving; 2/3; 3/4…). Smaller = gets denser faster. Converges to an R ceiling.
idlg.egyetlen_walk_forward_ablak: ⚠ Not a single walk-forward window can be formed — too little history. The optimisation would measure on the training data only.
idlg.a_vegrehajtasi_kapuk_ki: ⚠ The execution gates are switched OFF in the optimisation — the parameters you get will not match what live trading does.
idlg.a_mentett_minosites_csak: The saved rating is computed ONLY from the trades of the exam windows. The parameters and the rating therefore belong together — do not change one without the other.
idlg.nincs_orankenti_adat_az: No hourly data — the optimisation writes it into the saved rating. Run an optimisation.
idlg.oszlop_az_adott_ora: Column = that hour's P&L from the saved rating; the number below is the trade count. The faint ones are the hours switched off.
idlg.a_tarolt_leforditott_mas: ⚠ the stored compiled build is from a DIFFERENT SOURCE
idlg.belepo_jelzesek_csak_a: Entry signals: only the executable ones (filtered by spread / alignment / volatility)
idlg.kipipalva_azt_latod_amit: Ticked, you see what the engine would actually have traded. Unticked, EVERY signal shows — including the ones a gate would have blocked.
idlg.az_eles_kotesek_is: The LIVE trades too (what the bot actually opened)
idlg.ez_kulon_reteg_a: This is a SEPARATE layer next to the signals. For manual testing leave it empty: then only the signals show, not the bot's trades.
idlg.kapukkal_az_export_csak: ⚠ With gates on, the export shows ONLY the signals the engine would really trade.
idlg.a_pont_parameterei_betoltve: The point's parameters were loaded into the Parameters tab (not saved).

idlg.space_note:
{tuned} tuned dimensions ({signal} signal + {exec} execution), {space} combinations on the grid.
The optimisation samples {trials} of them — it does not walk the space, it learns from it. Fewer tuned dimensions = denser sample = more reliable result.

idlg.partial_never: ⚠ The partial close will NEVER trigger: the trigger is {trigger} R while the target (tp_rr_ratio) is {tp} R — the target gets there first and closes the WHOLE position. Put a smaller value in the trigger (e.g. {suggest}), or push tp_rr_ratio higher.

idlg3.atr_periodus_spread_kapu: ATR period (the volatility baseline for the spread gate + BE/trailing)
idlg3.spread_kapu_max_spread: Spread gate: max spread as a share of the ATR
idlg3.spread_kapu_also_kuszobe: The spread gate's lower threshold (this many times the normal spread)
idlg3.a_tp_hany_reszenel:
At what fraction of the TP the SL moves to the entry (0 = no BE).
Only has an effect on the 'BE + trailing' preset — Risky pulls BE at 1R, and Halving/Shield/Fibo/Thirds have their own rule.
idlg3.ennyi_atr_nyi_profit:
Trailing starts after this much ATR of profit.
Risky trails immediately, so it does not show there.
idlg3.ennyi_atr_rel_koveti:
The stop follows the price by this many ATR.
With Risky the engine halves this distance as well.
idlg3.hany_r_nel_zarja: At HOW MANY R it closes the part (Halving/Shield).
idlg3.ha_a_celar_ugyanide: ⚠ If the target falls at the same place (tp_rr_ratio = this), the partial
idlg3.zaras_soha_nem_hat: close NEVER applies: the target gets there first, and closes the WHOLE
idlg3.zarja_tegyel_ide_kisebbet: position. Put a smaller value here (e.g. 0.8) than tp_rr_ratio.
idlg3.a_felezo_ekkora_reszt: Halving closes this SHARE at the trigger (0.5 = half).
idlg3.a_pajzs_ekkora_reszt: Shield closes this SHARE at the trigger (0.75 = three quarters).
